description: This file contains Google Test unit tests for RFC API functions, including initialization, parameter retrieval and setting, error string mapping, and RFC enablement checks.

methods.name: init_rfcdefaults
methods.description: Initializes RFC defaults, tested for success and removal of default directory.

methods.name: getWriteCurlResponse
methods.description: External function to handle curl response writing, tested with mock data.

methods.name: writeToTr181storeFile
methods.description: Writes specific values to TR-181 store files, used in parameter retrieval tests.

methods.name: getRFCParameter
methods.description: Retrieves RFC parameters, tested with various parameter names and conditions.

methods.name: setRFCParameter
methods.description: Sets RFC parameters, tested with valid and invalid inputs.

methods.name: getRFCErrorString
methods.description: Maps error codes to descriptive strings, tested with multiple error codes.

methods.name: isRFCEnabled
methods.description: Checks if RFC is enabled for a given instance, expected to return false in test.
